preconditions.description: The integer k is between 1 and 26 inclusive.
The string q has length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in q)
preconditions.description: The string q consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by exactly k lines.
If the output is 'YES', the concatenation of the k subsequent lines equals the input string q.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and len(set(line[0] for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])) == k)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the first characters of the k strings are all distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(len(line) >= 1 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each of the k strings is non-empty.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and len(set(c for c in q)) >= k)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the number of distinct characters in q is at least k, which is a necessary condition for existence.
